priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_CRITICAL_EMERGENCY
priority_levels.description: Safety-critical satellite and system emergency signaling. Absolute preemption over all baseband activities.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_REALTIME_ISOCHRONOUS_AUDIO
priority_levels.description: Ultra Low Latency Audio (ULLA) and Bluetooth LE Audio CIS/BIS real-time packets. Critical for AirPods lip-sync and audio glitch prevention.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_SYNCHRONOUS_VOICE
priority_levels.description: Classic Bluetooth eSCO / SCO voice packets (2-EV3 / 3-EV3) for active phone calls and FaceTime audio.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_WIFI_BEACON_MANAGEMENT
priority_levels.description: Wi-Fi Target Beacon Transmission Time (TBTT) beacons, DTIM frames, and 802.11 association/auth handshakes.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_A2DP_BURST_STREAMING
priority_levels.description: High-bitrate A2DP music streaming (AAC-ELD / SBC) operating with adaptive buffer refill windows.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_LINK_CONTROL_SIGNALING
priority_levels.description: Bluetooth LMP / LL Control transactions, encryption key updates, channel sounding subevents, and Wi-Fi AC_VO traffic.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_INTERACTIVE_DATA
priority_levels.description: Wi-Fi AC_VI / AC_BE data frames, Bluetooth ACL user data, and Apple Watch companion sync.

priority_levels.name: PRIORITY_BACKGROUND_BEST_EFFORT
priority_levels.description: Find My background periodic advertising, BLE inquiry/page scans, and Wi-Fi AC_BK background bulk transfers.

bluetooth_activities.name: Ultra Low Latency Audio (ULLA) & LE Audio CIS

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: Stewie Satellite NTN vs Wi-Fi Beacon
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: Wi-Fi RF chain forced to high-impedance mode; beacon reception skipped until Stewie burst completes.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: Ultra Low Latency Audio (ULLA) vs Wi-Fi Beacon
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: ULLA audio packet is transmitted immediately. Wi-Fi beacon receiver rescheduled to next TBTT window via CTS-to-self frame protection.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: Ultra Low Latency Audio (ULLA) vs Wi-Fi AC_VO Voice
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: ULLA occupies 625 us slot. Wi-Fi AC_VO packet is delayed by FBF engine and transmitted immediately after ULLA slot finishes.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: Classic eSCO Voice vs Wi-Fi Beacon
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: eSCO slot is strictly reserved in hardware scripter. Wi-Fi beacon is delayed or received on secondary antenna path if diversity is available.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: A2DP Music Streaming vs Wi-Fi Beacon
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: A2DP burst yields 1.8 ms window to allow Wi-Fi beacon reception. Centauri A2DP packet queue increases burst rate post-beacon to refill buffer.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: A2DP Music Streaming vs Wi-Fi AC_BE Data
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: A2DP granted 20 ms transmission burst with 75% duty cycle. Wi-Fi AC_BE traffic is throttled using 802.11 CTS-to-self frame clamps.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: Bluetooth 5.4 Channel Sounding vs Wi-Fi AC_VI Video
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: Centauri coex engine coordinates CS active channel map with Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz channel to prevent phase tone corruption across adjacent channels.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: Find My IHSM Advertising vs Wi-Fi Beacon
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: Find My advertising packet is deferred by 20 ms to 50 ms pseudo-random delay, preventing RF collision with Wi-Fi beacon.

pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.conflict_case: BLE Discovery Scan vs Wi-Fi AC_BE Data
pairwise_conflict_arbitration_matrix.action_taken: Wi-Fi data transfer is granted antenna access. BLE scan window is paused and resumed during Wi-Fi inter-frame spaces (DIFS/EIFS).
